[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Block''' once [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE" /> waged between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the ''Negotiator'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Republic<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]<ref name="NEC" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="CSWE" />
